title: Departure Board
story: A station's departure board lists the day's trains by departure minute, earliest first; several trains may leave in the same minute. A passenger arrives at minute t and can catch any train leaving at t or later. Report the position, counting from 0, of the first train they can still catch. If every train has left, report the number of trains. The board is long, and the ticket machine may only take a few hundred steps.

notes: Times are whole minutes from 0 to 1,439, never decreasing along the board.

hints: Reading the board from the top until a train is late enough works, but a long board with a late passenger takes thousands of steps.
The board is in order, so looking at one train in the middle rules out half of the board at once.

Keep a low and a high position. If the middle train leaves before t, the answer is after it; otherwise the middle train itself may be the answer. Trains in the same minute: make sure you land on the first of them.
edgeCases: a passenger after the last train
several trains in the arrival minute
